sloka: सो ऽहं दानैश्च मानैश्च सततं पूजितस्त्वया ।सान्त्वैश्च विविधैः काले किं न कुर्यां प्रियं तव ।। ६.५७.१५ ।।।।
transliteration: so 'haṁ dānaiśca mānaiśca satataṁ pūjitastvayā ।sāntvaiśca vividhaiḥ kāle kiṁ na kuryāṁ priyaṁ tava ।। 6.57.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "You have always given me gifts, many honours and praises earlier and worshipped me. When time comes why will I not do"
